caption:
How to make your price list clear and readable with one AI prompt

If your prices live in a messy note full of slashes and question marks, customers end up messaging you to ask. Clean it up once.

Copy this:

"Turn this into a clear price list for customers. Group by service. One line each: name and price. Put add-ons in their own section. Don't change any prices. Flag anything unclear instead of guessing. List: [PASTE YOUR PRICES]"

I tried it on an invented nail salon list. It grouped hands, feet and add-ons, kept every price as written, and asked about the one item I'd marked with a question mark instead of inventing an answer.

Then put the clean version where people look: your bio link, a pinned post, the front desk.

Send this to someone who still explains their prices one DM at a time. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.
